breakdown.description: Engineering stress is defined with the original area A_0, not the final area A_f.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still uses A_f (final cross-sectional area = 115 mm²) instead of A_0 (original cross-sectional area = 130 mm²) to compute engineering stress. The ground truth defines engineering stress as P/A_0 with A_0 = 130 mm², yielding approximately 323.08 MPa. The agent repeated the original error by computing σe = 42,000 N / 115 mm² = 365.22 MPa, which is incorrect per the ground truth definition.
